title: Oasis @ 240
summary: Once a poorly-maintained, illegally-dumped city lot, the Oasis @ 240 is now a reclaimed community space with native flowers, a rain-catchment system, seating, and original art.

title: Community Center for Change
summary: Redeveloping a 5,000 sq ft former shipping company into an innovation hub for the 21229 — with a co-op grocery, multimedia center, and retail vending stalls.

title: Botanical Bus Stop
location: OLD FREDERICK RD & S MONASTERY AVE
summary: Turning a constant eyesore and dumping target into a beautified, living transit space shaped by food access, beauty, and care.

title: Little Memorial Garden
summary: In honor of Mr. Little, who tirelessly gardened this plot, CCD is restoring the garden to its former glory with raised beds, native plants, fruit trees, and an original mural.
